game_text: ▲ Lost In The Wilderness or a Rogue speeder. OR If you occupy a site, find one of your missing characters there. OR Cancel Stunning Leader. OR Cancel opponent’s attempt to randomly remove one or more cards from your hand (except with Monnok).
